war_economy.name: War economy

national_mourning.description: The country is grieving. Ordinary business waits.

postwar_settlement.description: The guns are quiet and the reconstruction budget is being spent.

investment_boom.description: Capital is arriving faster than anyone planned for.

austerity.description: The budget balances. Very little else does.

cultural_moment.description: For a while, the whole world is curious about this country.
